name: Old School Hash Co. | 2g Temple Ball | Black Cherry Gelato
description: Our hand-rolled Temple Ball, now available in a 2g size. This time packaged in a larger reusable tin and complete with a one hitter pipe for effortless enjoyment anywhere. This resinous hash form is a smooth, oily texture that softens with warmth; allowing you to easily infuse your own joints by rolling small pieces into snakes. This full melt product can be added to any session or smoked by itself.
